summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Expanded the US-listed universe for the advanced packaging, HBM backend, OSAT, and memory package/test capacity node. This pass keeps one obvious direct OSAT reference name and prioritizes underfollowed small/mid-cap or niche equipment/test beneficiaries. The strongest Layer 1B exposures found are AMKR as a direct OSAT capacity anchor, CAMT as an advanced packaging/HBM inspection and metrology supplier with recent AI/HBM orders, FORM as a probe-card/test-interface supplier tied to HBM and DRAM test intensity, and KLIC as a thermo-compression/advanced assembly equipment supplier with AI, CPO, heterogeneous integration, and emerging HBM relevance. These are research candidates only, not recommendations. Expanded the US-listed universe around the advanced-packaging/HBM-backend capacity node with a two-lane bias toward underfollowed second-order suppliers rather than HBM producers. The strongest US-listed direct OSAT candidate is Amkor; the cleaner underfollowed equipment and test-tool lane includes Kulicke & Soffa, Onto Innovation, and FormFactor. Key chokepoint logic remains a hypothesis: AI/HBM demand may crowd out conventional memory backend and advanced package/test capacity, raising utilization or tool demand for qualified OSATs and packaging/test equipment vendors.
